The first little drop.

Start with the J'S Classic Cinnamon Roll for 450 EGP, delivery included anywhere in Alexandria. Send your order request on WhatsApp and we’ll confirm availability.

Good to know

Before the
first bite.

Where do you deliver?

We deliver across all Alexandria. The listed 450 EGP price already includes delivery, so there is no separate delivery charge.

How do I place an order?

Add the Classic Cinnamon Roll to your order, enter your contact and address details, then send the prefilled request through WhatsApp. Your order is confirmed only after J'S replies.

How much does it cost?

Each Classic Cinnamon Roll is 450 EGP, with delivery included anywhere in Alexandria. Your cart calculates the total by quantity.

How can I pay?

After J'S confirms your order, pay the displayed total through InstaPay to 01284184425. Send your transfer proof on WhatsApp. Payment is manually verified before preparation.

Can I request a different flavour?

The launch menu currently features the Classic Cinnamon Roll only. More treats may be introduced later.
